Bug_Title: VA: Primitive array passed to function expecting a variable number of object arguments (VA_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_PASSED_TO_OBJECT_VARARG)
Bug_Details:
This code passes a primitive array to a function that takes a variable number of object arguments.
This creates an array of length one to hold the primitive array and passes it to the function.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where an int array is passed to the printObjects method which expects a variable number of Object arguments. This results in the int array being treated as a single object rather than individual integers.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method with an integer array, which triggers the bug because the int array is passed to the printObjects method expecting a variable number of Object arguments. This causes the int array to be treated as a single object rather than individual integers.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results show the output '[I@29444d75', which is the default string representation of an integer array object in Java. This indicates that the primitive array was passed as a single object to the varargs method, confirming the bug where a primitive array is passed to a function expecting a variable number of object arguments.
